controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by TOI-1064; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured color.
controls.notes: No image or color of TOI-1064 c is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the color of toi-1064's light, as its color dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of TOI-1064's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1064 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

TOI-1064 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (94, 104, 105) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 79748331, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 24 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
